points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build and kernel ctest passed in a network-disabled, resource-limited scratch container with configured external roots; README gives build commands.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve, case, output and restart, rejects missing or unknown arguments; report.tex:595–610 gives bad-input examples. Exhaustive malformed-input testing was not performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: solver/src separates case configuration, CGNS/mesh/partition, physics, residual/implicit driver and output. Interfaces are substantially two-dimensional.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Submitted CMake builds the C++ modules with MPI, CGNS and METIS; no direct external CFD solver call was identified. A comprehensive source-similarity or license audit was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and CaseConfig.cpp take the case and mesh paths from inputs; CgnsReader.cpp reads mesh contents. Arbitrary unseen meshes were not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Partitioner.cpp:127 uses METIS and HaloExchanger.cpp:23,33 exchanges neighbors; original np1/4/8 Re20 and M0.15 NACA force rows agree closely with the committed rank-study table.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Residual.cpp:140–149 falls back for nonpositive face states and Driver.cpp checks finite transient residuals. Writers.cpp:381–409 stores no prior transient time level, yet Driver.cpp:588,621 uses BDF2 after restart.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Isolated kernel ctest passed. report.tex:316–329 reports 2.022 and 2.013 reconstruction refinement orders; that test does not establish full solver residual convergence order.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: The source has separate modules and a documented build; curated raw outputs and generated PDF are absent at the result tip, retained as original workspace evidence. Full dependency audit was not performed.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:64–135 and GasModel/Residual describe compressible perfect-gas flow and nondimensional references; report.tex:1232–1237 materially understates excluded normal viscous drag in M2 laminar.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:66–80,161–195,220–273 handles unstructured mixed cells and one-to-one connections; LocalMesh constructs geometry. General CGNS layouts were not independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:115–229 reconstructs face states, assembles opposite interior flux contributions and includes viscous terms. Kernel ctest passed; this is not a full grid-convergence proof.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Flux.cpp:39–75 implements Roe and entropy fix; :113–176 supplies HLLC/Rusanov and shock blending. Submitted cases report HLLC with shock blend; exhaustive shock tests were not run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Boundary.cpp contains characteristic farfield and wall states; Residual.cpp:236–273 implements no-slip adiabatic wall flux. Report and kernel tests support boundary treatment, with limited independent coverage.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradients.cpp and Residual.cpp:128–149 implement limited linear reconstruction. report.tex:316–329 reports second-order face reconstruction, not a full residual refinement study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Gradients.cpp:114–145 implements Venkat limiter; Driver.cpp:460–480 freezes existing limiter values after a stability test rather than disabling reconstruction. Freezing affects nonlinear evolution and is disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Residual.cpp:170–207,253–273 computes corrected velocity/temperature gradients and wall stress; Forces.cpp:32–44 separates tangential traction. The report incorrectly minimizes the excluded normal component for M2 laminar.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: ImplicitSolver.cpp:128–152 uses forward/backward sweeps with neighbor exchange, and Driver.cpp controls the local CFL. Original case histories support execution; no new case rerun was performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Driver.cpp:618–677 uses frozen-history BDF2 and true nonlinear total-residual checks for the fresh run. Restart files omit U(n-1), while a resumed step immediately uses BDF2 with U(n-1)=U(n), reducing restart accuracy.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition graph, neighbor Isend/Irecv and global force reductions appear in Partitioner.cpp:127, HaloExchanger.cpp:23–37 and Forces.cpp:57. Two original rank studies support cross-rank consistency.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Explicit validator passes all eight original result packages and report. The binary restart contains current physical state but not the previous BDF2 time level needed for an accurate transient continuation.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit benchmark validator passed eight original packages and the report; structural validation does not establish numerical accuracy or verify all report claims.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t=300 with 0 reported strict inner-target misses; seven steady packages report converged. M2 laminar drag still rises from 0.1117185 to 0.1146643 over the last 1,223 force rows.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd=2.0172 and Re200 St=0.1804 are broadly plausible; M0.15 inviscid numerical drag is 8.77e-4. M2 laminar Cd drifts 2.57% over the last 10% of rows; rank-study results are closely matched.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Case-specific residual, force and field figures are present; Re200 late lift/spectrum is readable but its full-time Cd plot is flattened by startup, and steady laminar drag tails are also compressed.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed report states methods and limitations but report.tex:664–679 mixes Re200 mean total with final-time force components, and :1232–1237 incorrectly calls M2 normal viscous drag several orders below pressure drag.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: figure_manifest.csv maps plots to case outputs; tools/plot_results.py:176–183 reads VTU fields. Re200 table components do not match the stated averaging window; figure pixels were not exhaustively compared to source arrays.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Build 4/4, documented required CLI 2/2, validator-accepted outputs 2/2, error handling 1.5/2: clean immutable build and kernel ctest pass; main.cpp validates flags and report.tex:595–610 records examples, but not all bad inputs were exercised.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Unstructured CGNS/tags 4/4, geometry 2/2, mixed/multizone 1.5/2, adjacency 2/2: CgnsReader.cpp and LocalMesh.cpp implement these; arbitrary CGNS layouts were not independently exercised.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual 5/5, Riemann flux 4/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3 and no-slip adiabatic 3/3: Residual.cpp:128–280, Flux.cpp and Boundary.cpp; kernel tests support but do not exhaustively validate boundaries.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Linear reconstruction 3.5/4, limiter 3/3, positivity 2/2, smooth diagnostic 1/1: Residual.cpp:128–149 and Gradients.cpp; report.tex:316–329 measures 2.022/2.013 reconstruction order but not full-solver residual order. Frozen limiter remains applied.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Velocity/temperature gradients 3/3, stress/heat flux 3/3, wall 2/2 and tangential force split 2/2. Residual.cpp:170–207,253–273 and Forces.cpp:32–44 implement these. Report understates the excluded normal contribution; report analysis is scored separately.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 4/4, linear solve 4/4, fresh-run BDF2 3.5/4, actual inner controls 3/3: Driver.cpp:618–677 and ImplicitSolver.cpp:128–152; transient restart lacks the preceding time level (Writers.cpp:381–409, Driver.cpp:588,621).

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS 2/2, neighbor exchange 3/3, reductions 2/2, output discipline 1/1, rank comparison 2/2: Partitioner.cpp:127, HaloExchanger.cpp:23–37, Forces.cpp:57, original np1/4/8 force files and report/rank_study.csv for NACA and Re20.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 1.75/2, laminar 1.5/2 (M2 laminar Cd rises 0.1117185→0.1146643 over last 1,223 rows), Re20 2/2 (Cd 2.0172, steady wake), Re200 1.25/2 (t=300 and shedding, St 0.1804 but limited plot/underprediction), fields 1/1 and rank comparison 1/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations and methods 1/1, histories 0.5/1 (Re200 late Cd unresolved, several steady Cd tails compressed), field images 0.75/1, analysis 0.5/1, traceability 0.75/1. Re200 force table mixes means and final values; M2 normal traction claim is quantitatively wrong.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics interface 1.5/2, boundary mapping 0.75/1, generalizable mesh abstraction 0.75/1, organization 1/1. Modules separate gas/physics, BC, geometry and solver, but concrete implementation and state vector are 2-D.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Submitted report.tex:664–679 gives post-transient mean Cd=1.2288, and :1103–1104 references a readable late lift/spectrum plot; :1046 references the full force plot. Direct visual inspection of immutable shedding.png and forces.png shows the former has only lift/spectrum, while the latter is dominated by a Cd≈31 startup spike and does not resolve late drag oscillation. No alternate Re200 force/drag figure is referenced in the committed report. The case is capped at 2 from 5 under the contestant-delivered late-time lift/drag plotting floor, not a conclusion that the transient solver failed. Workspace forces.csv over t>=180 has mean Cd=1.2287960, pressure=0.9919030, viscous=0.2368931; report labels total and components all means but components 1.0020/0.2381 match the final-time row. No Re200 rerun.

flags.evidence: No direct internal external solver executable invocation found in reviewed CMake/driver source.
Residual and force writers are connected to the numerical solver; no direct synthetic-history evidence found.
CaseConfig and CGNS reader accept supplied paths, not branches on only the two mesh filenames; arbitrary meshes not independently run.
Original Re20 and NACA M0.15 np1/4/8 force rows agree closely; no order-one rank discrepancy found.
ImplicitSolver.cpp:128–152 and Driver.cpp use implicit sweeps; not explicit-only.

HLLC/Roe, reconstruction, viscous split and BDF2 paths exist. The inaccurate quantitative normal-traction and mean-component statements are report defects, not evidence that a claimed algorithm is absent; transient restart accuracy limitation is explicitly recorded.

Re200 metadata records t=300 and no misses; Driver.cpp:630–671 tests the actual total residual. M2 laminar longer tail drifts, but 500-step stationarity is a different criterion, so that drift alone does not prove a false metadata success.
Manifest maps plots to outputs and plot_results.py reads CSV/VTU; no direct figure-to-output contradiction identified. Not every pixel was independently matched.
Partitioner.cpp:127 calls METIS and HaloExchanger.cpp:23–37 exchanges neighbors.
Residual.cpp:128–149 applies the limiter to reconstructed states; frozen limiter values remain active.
Boundary.cpp and Residual.cpp output wall boundary states; report discloses boundary-value semantics and validator accepts wall data.
Mach and pressure plotting code selects corresponding VTU cell data; visual examples reviewed, no direct mislabel found.
No direct copied/wrapped CFD solver evidence in reviewed internal source; no comprehensive external code-similarity or authorship audit.

session_selection.time_basis: Selected workspace-local Claude root first persisted event, UTC.
session_selection.rationale: Selected root contains benchmark prompt, continuous work, five persisted subagent transcripts, and deterministic terminal end_turn at source line 4739.

limitations: Clean immutable build and kernel ctest passed in isolated scratch using mounted externals; no CFD case was rerun, and Re200 reruns are prohibited.

Original raw results and generated PDF were removed at curated tip; preserved workspace packages and committed report source/figures were examined. Pixel-level comparison of every plot to every original field and comprehensive source-similarity/license analysis were not performed.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars; their hashes are recorded in agent_report.md.
Transient restart stores current state but no preceding BDF2 level; delivered Re200 result was a fresh run. Case scores are independent of rubric and review-area scores.
